case_name: Jyoti W/O Parameshwar Bhustalimath vs Parameshwar S/O Panchakshari ... on 6 July, 2023

parties.respondent_defendant: Parameshwar S/O Panchakshari Bhustalimat (husband) and Tarabai W/O Panchakshari Bhustalimat (mother-in-law)

facts_of_case: The parties were married under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The trial court dissolved the marriage and granted maintenance to the wife. The husband died during the pendency of this appeal.

legal_principles.principle: Equitable considerations must prevail where the position is not free from doubt.
legal_principles.held: where this is so, equitable considerations must prevail and bearing in mind the nature of the conclusion; the far-reaching effect of the findings of the Court, both on personal status and property rights, it is desirable that the party aggrieved by the decree of the trial Court must have the opportunity to have the findings reversed and this opportunity must be assured irrespective of the death of the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: The party aggrieved by the decree of the trial Court must have the opportunity to have the findings reversed.
legal_principles.held: it is desirable that the party aggrieved by the decree of the trial Court must have the opportunity to have the findings reversed and this opportunity must be assured irrespective of the death of the respondent.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed, and the impugned judgment and decree are set aside.
